name: Vocabulary Bot
purpose: Production-ready bilingual English vocabulary Telegram bot
changes: Two-stage semantic Bangla-meaning audit with conservative correction overlay
Confirmed-wrong meanings can be corrected at runtime; confirmed-correct meanings remain unchanged
Uncertain meaning audits retain the original source meaning and no longer abort the entire five-word run
Verified meaning corrections are propagated to both photo-card and rich-post publishing paths
Meaning-audit cache is versioned so old uncertain audit decisions are re-evaluated
Capitalize first character of every displayed word/meaning in Synonyms, Antonyms and Word Family tables
Switch pronunciation rich block from voice note to standard RichBlockAudio for a streamable audio player
Invalidate prior media cache and content cache entries when meaning/content format changes
Preserve approved photo card generator and logo unchanged
safety: High-confidence wrong meaning requires verified correction; uncertain cases keep source data
Source database is never overwritten by automatic corrections
Meaning corrections persist in vocabulary state
Content cache includes a meaning fingerprint
Meaning-correction propagation regression test prevents stale source meanings from reaching publication
